note: BH-9938 (BH-9926 wave 6): settings row lane.wake-loop.gh_source. Where the pr-lead wake class (bin/lib/wake-class-pr-lead.sh) reads a PR's state, draft and head sha (today a pulls/<n> read): off = GitHub only; shadow (default) = the PR record and GitHub, the class acts on GitHub and logs one PRR_SHADOW line in logs/prr-shadow.log when they differ; record = the PR record only, 0 GitHub calls on a fresh hit, and a record miss reads GitHub and logs PRR_MISS. A record hit does not spend the class's GitHub reads cap. Any other value is shadow plus one PRR_STEP line. Read by prr_step in bin/lib/prr-shadow.sh; the read is bin/lib/prr-shadow.d/wake-loop.sh.
